name: Omatint
author: Mister.Oshimaida
description: Tint the whole screen in a comfortable translucent colour — green, amber, yellow or red. A click-through overlay that never blocks the desktop, with an on/off bar button, colour swatches and a live strength slider.

barWidget.description: Click: toggle the tint. Right-click: colour, strength and settings

schema.label: Tint strength (%)
schema.description: How strong the tint is when it is switched on. Right-click the bar button to change it live.

schema.label: Tint colour
schema.description: green: least irritating tint (green light is the least photophobic) — a daytime comfort wash, not a night filter. amber: warm night filter (best evidence for cutting the melatonin-suppressing 460-500 nm band). yellow: daytime contrast/glare tint. red: strongest night mode, preserves melatonin and night vision.

schema.label: Use the night-light key
schema.description: When on, Super+Ctrl+N toggles this tint instead of the stock night light.

schema.label: Eye-rest reminder
schema.description: Send a notification after the tint has been on for the interval below.

schema.label: Reminder interval (minutes)
schema.description: Minutes of continuous tint time before the eye-rest notification fires.
